profile.name: PRG CORPORATION PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: Patum Rice Mill and Granary Public Company Limited (PRG) is the producer and distributor of milled rice for the local and the international market. PRG's products are milled rice packed in plastic bag of 2 kgs. and 5 kgs. and in polypropylene bag of 15 kgs., 48 kgs., 49 kgs., and 50 kgs. PRG brands are 'Mah Boonkrong' , ' Mah Boonkrong Plus', and 'Jasmine Gold'  PRG is also doing business of restaurant and food court.

profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has the policy to pay out dividend to shareholders under normal circumstances, at no less than 30% of its net profits, with the calculation of the dividend based on "the consolidated financial statements".
